title: Toybox After Hours: Closing Shift
about: Take the overnight toy-store cleanup shift. Return plushies, dragons, and robots to their places, repair the broken ones, and finish before sunrise.

controls.desc: Move through the shop in first person
Look around, including up and down
Pick up, load another toy onto the trolley, shelf, place on the bench, or place on the floor
Cycle which carried toy is active
Open or close the shop tools screen
Hide the first-shift guide; replay it from Settings
Pause, adjust settings, or open How to Play
Save or resume cleanup progress (Ctrl+S / Ctrl+L also work)
Start a fresh shift or replay this exact layout (R / F5 also work)
All required movement, sorting, recovery, menu, and pause actions are visible on screen
